messages.subject: Using verbatimtab instead of verbatim
parts:
Latex seems to be omitting leading tabs in verbatim blocks. E.g. try:

<<>>=
#pretty indented json:
cat(toJSON(list(foo=1:3), pretty=T))
@

The verbatimtab environment in the moreverb package fixes this. Is there anything I can put in the preamble to use verbatimtab where knitr produces output with verbatim? I tried

\usepackage{verbatim}
\usepackage{moreverb}
\renewcommand{\verbatim}{\verbatimtab}

But that resulted in a bunch of errors.

I should have added that this function is part of RJSONIO. So try:

<<>>=
#pretty indented json:
library(RJSONIO)
cat(toJSON(list(foo=1:3), pretty=T))
@

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: Using verbatimtab instead of verbatim
parts:
You can solve this problem from either of the two directions: you were
trying to do it from the LaTeX direction, i.e. redefine the verbatim
environment; or you can replace verbatim with verbatimtab in the chunk
output:

<<setup, include=FALSE>>=
hook_chunk = knit_hooks$get('chunk')
knit_hooks$set(chunk = function(x, options) {
out = hook_chunk(x, options)
gsub('\\\\(begin|end)\\{verbatim\\}', '\\\\\\1{verbatimtab}', out)
})
@
